newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean three-year bond yields close higher.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean three-year bond yields close higher.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed higher due to a market talk that some banks had difficulty in building cash reserves, dealers said.
The overnight call rate remained unchanged and three-month CD yields closed lower.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.05 pct vs Monday's 11.98
* 3-mth CDs end at 14.10 pct vs Monday's 14.20
* Overnight call average unchanged at 16.50 pct
